messages:
jeff_s: passing HelioPay -> CS. Signed PO today; customer wants private VPC for PHI, SSO (SAML), and an on-prem option evaluation. Go-live target 2026-06-15 (~8 weeks). Trial traffic estimate: 300 qps peak, ~30M tokens/month. Rep: Jeff.

maria_c: Thanks — taking lead. Quick question: do they require Dedicated capacity or just the private control plane? Any customer-managed KMS / HSM requirements?

jeff_s: Committed to Dedicated (reserved GPUs) + private control plane. They asked for customer-managed KMS (HSM preferred), SOC2 + HIPAA compliance. Also asked about model quantization vs accuracy for clinical summarization workflows.

maria_c: Noted. I'll schedule kickoff with solutions eng + support. @dave_l can you own model & inference recommendations (latency vs quality) and run a small eval on their sample prompts?

dave_l: On it. Please drop the prompt set + a small labeled dataset. Also need max seq length and whether real-time p95 latency SLO is <150ms or higher.

jeff_s: Uploaded sample prompts here: https://drive.redwood/heliopay/prompt-set.csv. Latency SLO: 200ms p95 acceptable for chat; async batch reports ok to be higher. Seq length: up to 4096 tokens on summaries.

rachel_t: I'll open a CS->Support->ENG escalation ticket and start the network/VPC checklist. Priority: HIGH. Ticket will include SSO, KMS, IP allowlist, and provisioning request for Dedicated GPUs (NVIDIA H100).

maria_c: Action items: 1) Dave — eval + model variant recommendations by 2026-03-22. 2) Rachel — create support ticket and begin VPC/network review by 2026-03-18. 3) Jeff — confirm BAA/legal contact and any additional compliance docs. 4) Maria — schedule kickoff (target 2026-03-20) and own timeline.

jeff_s: HelioPay security lead: Anita Ramos <anita@heliopay.com>. Confirmed BAA required.

dave_l: Quick note from initial glance: suggestion is fine-tuned 7B with 4-bit quant on Dedicated to hit cost targets and latency; keep 13B as fallback for high-accuracy canary testing. I'll produce perf numbers (latency, throughput) and token-cost estimates in the eval.

rachel_t: Ticket created: R-2026-4389. Attached infra PR stub and initial network diagram. Also added a task to provision a staging Dedicated pool and whitelist HelioPay CIDR. Adding on-call rotation for first two weeks post-go-live.

maria_c: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. I'll post calendar invite and a living owners doc in the shared drive. If anything blocks infra (SAML metadata, IPs, certificate exchange), ping here and I'll escalate.

jeff_s: One more business note: renewal risk flagged — HelioPay requested removing usage-based overages at renewal unless we convert to a committed plan. Marking as 'at-risk' until finance and customer agree on renewal structure.

maria_c: Marked renewal risk and will loop in finance during kickoff. I'll capture negotiation points in the owners doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: Kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-03-20 10:00 PT (created by maria_c).
